subject: Temporary headroom concession & PO flow for peak launch
messages:
From: Alex Moran <alex@launchpad.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@launchpad.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected spike during rollout — short-term headroom request

Hi Ben,

Quick note — we kicked off a partial launch for Launchpad's new recommendations engine this morning and traffic spiked ~3x above our forecast. We're throttled at the moment and it's blocking session-level flows for a subset of users.

Can Redwood provision a short-term headroom bump (roughly 48–72 hours) while we stabilize? We expect the sustained load to settle back down but need immediate capacity to avoid customer impact.

Two asks from our side:
- Can you enable an emergency uplift to our throughput threshold for 72 hours?
- If there are overrun charges, can you provide a price concession/credit so we don't get hit with a full overage invoice for what looks like a launch-related anomaly?

If needed we can route a PO from procurement to cover provisional capacity — procurement (cc'd) is looped. Appreciate any fast path you can offer.

Thanks,
Alex Moran
Head of Platform
Launchpad.ai

Attachment: none
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Alex Moran <alex@launchpad.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, procurement@launchpad.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike during rollout — short-term headroom request

Alex —

Thanks for the heads up and sorry to hear about the disruption. We can move quickly here. Proposed emergency path below: 

1) Provisional headroom: we can double your current quota for up to 72 hours starting as soon as you confirm.
2) Billing/credit: we will cap overrun exposure for this event — overrun beyond commitment will be billed at your current overage rate but Redwood will apply a 25% concession (credit) on the overrun line for the first 72 hours. That concession applies only to usage attributable to the launch window.
3) PO/contract: to make this effective immediately we need either (a) a brief signed PO referencing your existing master services agreement, or (b) us to issue a short amendment (attached) that you sign electronically. Either works.

I've attached a 1‑page provisional-headroom-term-sheet that outlines the timelines, the credit calculation, and the acceptance path. If procurement can send a PO, Finance will accept and flag the invoice note for credit once usage is reconciled.

If this is acceptable I can flip the switch as soon as procurement confirms and we get a PO or signed amendment. I'm standing by.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0129

Attachment: provisional-headroom-term-sheet.pdf (PDF, 14KB)

Hi Ben / Marissa,

We can issue a PO immediately to cover provisional capacity. A couple of clarifying items for legal/finance:
- Please confirm whether the proposed concession is recorded as an invoice-level credit (post-reconciliation) or a reduced rate applied up front.
- Procurement will need a one-page statement of work / amendment that references the MSA and includes an estimated not-to-exceed amount for the provisional uplift.

I've attached a draft PO for your reference and EMILY is our billing contact (emily.white@launchpad.ai). If you can route an amendment to sign today we will return a countersigned PO in the afternoon.

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Moran <alex@launchpad.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@launchpad.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Unexpected spike — need approval on concession structure

Marissa / Karthik —

Looping you both for quick approval. Launchpad has an urgent launch spike; procurement will send a PO if we provide an amendment. My recommended terms:

- Provision: up to 2x quota for a 72-hour window starting on activation.
- Credit: 25% concession on the overrun line item for usage within the 72-hour window. Rounded to nearest dollar and applied as a post-event invoice credit after reconciliation.
- Cap: Redwood's max liability for the concession should be capped at $12,000 for this event. Overrun beyond that is billed normally.
- Activation: we can activate immediately once procurement returns a signed PO or once they execute our amendment via DocuSign.

Rationale: keeps the customer live, limits Redwood exposure, and gives finance a clean reconciliation flow (invoice credit post-event). We should confirm the cap with Finance.

Can you both reply with approve / approve with edit / no-go? I'll hold activation until we have a thumbs-up.

Thanks,
Ben

Subject: Re: Fwd: Unexpected spike — need approval on concession structure

Ben / Karthik —

Approve with one small change: please make the credit mechanism explicit as a reconciled invoice credit (post-event) and retain the $12k cap. Finance will accept that path provided we include a short memo on the invoice that ties usage windows to the credit.

Also, we should require Launchpad to include an acceptance checkbox on the PO or amendment confirming the uplift window and the capped credit — avoids later disputes.

Once you have procurement's signed PO or the countersigned amendment, activate and notify Finance (cc karthik).

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Alex Moran <alex@launchpad.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@launchpad.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 31 Jul 2025 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Provisional headroom activated pending PO — next steps & amendment

Alex / Procurement —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per procurement's note we prepared a short amendment and an activation checklist: please see attached amendment_v1.pdf. Key points:
- Activation: Redwood will enable a 72-hour provisional headroom (2x quota) on receipt of a signed PO or countersigned amendment.
- Billing: Overrun billed at your existing overage rate; Redwood will apply a 25% invoice credit on overrun usage attributable to the 72-hour window, capped at $12,000. Credit applied after usage reconciliation.
- Acceptance: Amendment includes a checkbox for acceptance of the uplift window and the credit cap (per Finance request).

Please review and either (A) send back a signed PO referencing your MSA (we will mark the invoice note) or (B) sign the amendment via DocuSign. Once we have that, we will activate immediately and confirm the activation time in a follow-up.

I've attached a stub of the signed PO we expect (signed-po-stub.pdf) and the amendment (amendment_v1.pdf). Looping Marissa and Karthik for finance/legal visibility.

Thanks — standing by to activate.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
